name: What is the step-by-step process for installing garage drywall?

mainEntity.name: What is the step-by-step process for installing garage drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hanging garage drywall involves framing verification, hanging sheet goods, joint finishing, and surface preparation. The crew first inspects studs for plumb and true alignment, adding blocking where needed. Insulation and rough-in electrical work are verified before hanging 5/8-inch or 1/2-inch panels horizontally to minimize seams. Corner beads are installed on outside edges. Next, multiple coats of joint compound and tape are applied to fasteners and joints. After proper curing and sanding, walls are vacuumed and prepared for primer, interior paint, or trim carpentry.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes inspecting framing, installing insulation, fastening drywall sheets, applying tape and joint compound, sanding smooth, and prepping surfaces for paint.
